title: Breath-Dx: A Time Series Classification Benchmark for Disease Screening with eNose
abstract: arXiv:2611.15348v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Electronic nose (eNose) technology offers a portable, non-invasive route for disease screening via exhaled breath analysis. However, progress in the field is hindered by the lack of systematic benchmarks that compare machine learning methods under realistic conditions, particularly sensor drift, a known but rarely quantified failure mode. Most existing studies rely on small, private datasets with inconsistent protocols, rendering results non-comparable and slowing progress. We introduce Breath-Dx, the first comprehensive benchmark of time series classification methods for breath-based disease screening. Our work leverages the Scent of Health (S-OH) dataset, the largest public clinical eNose collection to date, comprising 1,234 patients across nine diagnostic groups, each providing a 17-channel multivariate time series with explicit temporal train/test splits that account for sensor drift. translated_title: Breath-Dx：基于电子鼻进行疾病筛查的时间序列分类基准
translated_abstract: 电子鼻技术通过呼出气体分析为疾病筛查提供了一种便携、无创的途径。然而，该领域的进展受到缺乏在现实条件下比较机器学习方法的系统性基准的阻碍，尤其是传感器漂移这一已知却很少被量化的失效模式。大多数现有研究依赖于协议不一致的小型私有数据集，导致结果无法相互比较，从而拖慢了领域进展。我们提出了 Breath-Dx，这是首个针对基于呼气疾病筛查的时间序列分类方法的综合性基准。我们的工作利用了 Scent of Health (S-OH) 数据集——迄今最大的公开临床电子鼻数据集，涵盖九个诊断组共 1,234 名患者，每位患者提供 17 通道的多变量时间序列，并采用显式的时间顺序训练/测试划分以考虑传感器漂移的影响。我们系统评估了 10 种方法，涵盖……
tldr: 本文提出了 Breath-Dx——首个针对电子鼻呼气疾病筛查的时间序列分类综合基准，基于迄今最大的公开临床电子鼻数据集 S-OH（涵盖 9 个诊断组 1,234 名患者），并通过考虑传感器漂移的时间划分实现了方法间的公平、可比评估。
en_tdlr: Breath-Dx introduces the first comprehensive benchmark for time series classification in eNose-based breath disease screening, leveraging the largest public clinical eNose dataset (S-OH, 1,234 patients across 9 diagnostic groups) with drift-aware temporal train/test splits for fair and comparable evaluation of machine learning methods.
